connect.oauthLink: Connect **{provider}** from the dashboard — OAuth has to start from your signed-in dashboard session: {url}
connect.needsTarget: Give both `target` and `channel` to connect **{provider}** here, or run `/integration alerts add` afterwards to add watch targets.
connect.webhookGuidance: **{provider}** connects via a webhook. Use `/integration webhook create` to set up an inbound endpoint and get its URL/secret.
connect.unavailable: **{provider}** isn't fully configured on this server yet: missing {missingEnv}. The connection was still created and will start working once that's set.

disconnect.confirmBody: This stops alerts/polling for **{provider}** (`{label}`) and removes any stored OAuth token. You can reconnect any time.

list.title: Connections
list.empty: No integrations connected yet. Try `/integration connect` or `/integration alerts add`.

status.title: Twitch chat status
status.botConfigured: 🟢 Pavisie's Twitch bot account is connected — `{login}`.
status.botNotConfigured: 🔴 Pavisie's Twitch bot account hasn't been connected yet (owner setup pending).
status.runtimeConnected: 🟢 Connected to Twitch chat — {count} channel(s) joined.
status.noChannels: No Twitch channels linked yet. Run `/twitch setup` to connect one.
status.rewardsEnabledOverlayReady: 🟢 Channel points on — overlay set up
status.rewardsEnabledNoOverlay: 🟡 Channel points on — overlay not set up yet (see `/twitch setup`)
status.rewardsRelinkRequired: 🔴 Channel points on but **re-link required** — the broadcaster needs to reconnect this channel from the dashboard to grant permission to read channel-point redemptions

setup.instructions:
Connect a Twitch channel from the dashboard: **Dashboard → this server → Integrations → "Twitch chat" tab → Connect a Twitch channel**.
{url}
setup.rewardsInstructions: To run channel-point reward actions (sound/TTS/chat/Discord): **Dashboard → this server → Integrations → "Twitch chat" tab → the channel's Rewards section → enable → copy the overlay URL**, then add that URL as a Browser Source in OBS. Configure the rewards themselves with `/twitch reward add`.
setup.botNotConfiguredNote: Note: Pavisie's Twitch bot account isn't set up yet — ask the bot owner to finish that first.

off.confirmBody: This disables Pavisie in every linked Twitch channel for this server. You can turn a channel back on from the dashboard.
off.done: Twitch chat turned off for this server.
off.noChannels: No Twitch channels are linked for this server.

errors.channelRequired: This server has more than one linked Twitch channel — specify `channel`.
errors.noChannels: No Twitch channels are linked for this server yet. Run `/twitch setup` first.
errors.invalidName: Must be 1-32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, or underscore.
errors.reservedName: "{name}" is a built-in command name and can't be overridden.
errors.commandExists: A command named "{name}" already exists for this channel.
errors.commandNotFound: No command named "{name}" was found for this channel.
errors.commandLimit: This channel has reached its limit of {max} commands.
errors.timerExists: A timer named "{name}" already exists for this channel.
errors.timerNotFound: No timer named "{name}" was found for this channel.
errors.timerLimit: This channel has reached its limit of {max} timers.
errors.rewardExists: A reward action for "{name}" with that action type already exists for this channel.
errors.rewardNotFound: No reward action named "{name}" was found for this channel.
errors.rewardAmbiguous: "{name}" matches more than one reward action (different action types) for this channel — remove it from the dashboard instead.
errors.rewardLimit: This channel has reached its limit of {max} reward actions.

command.listEmpty: No custom commands yet. Add one with `/twitch command add`.

timer.listEmpty: No timers yet. Add one with `/twitch timer add`.

reward.added: Added a **{action}** reward action for "{title}" on **{channel}**.
reward.removeConfirmBody: This deletes the reward action for "{title}" on **{channel}**.
reward.listEmpty: No reward actions yet. Add one with `/twitch reward add`.
reward.enabledRelinkRequired: Channel-point rewards are now **on** for **{channel}**, but redemptions cannot be read yet — the broadcaster needs to reconnect this channel from the dashboard to grant permission. **Dashboard → this server → Integrations → Twitch chat → Connect a Twitch channel**.
reward.overlayResetConfirmBody: This creates a new URL and invalidates the previous one. Any OBS source using the old URL will stop working for **{channel}**.
reward.overlayResetDone: Overlay URL regenerated for **{channel}**. Get the new URL with `/twitch reward overlay`.
